description: This source file implements CPU detection logic for different architectures (x86_64, ARM64) within the Abseil library, including vendor identification and CPU type classification.

classes.name: Vendor
classes.description: Enumeration for CPU vendor types (Unknown, Intel, AMD).

classes.name: CpuType
classes.description: Enumeration for specific CPU types (e.g., Intel Westmere, AMD Naples).

methods.name: GetVendor
methods.description: Detects CPU vendor by executing CPUID with eax=0.

methods.name: GetIntelCpuType
methods.description: Determines specific Intel CPU model based on CPUID leaf 1.

methods.name: GetAmdCpuType
methods.description: Determines specific AMD CPU model based on CPUID leaf 1.

methods.name: GetCpuType
methods.description: Main function to identify CPU type based on vendor.

methods.name: SupportsArmCRC32PMULL
methods.description: Checks if ARM CPU supports CRC32 with PMULL.
